authorship: Original text authored prospectively by the independent evaluation agent in this session; no external teacher, corpus samples, model generations or sealed conversations consulted.

generation.decoding: Freeze deterministic decoding before step-zero evaluation; use the same settings at each milestone.

counterfactual.scoring: Score every token of each full continuation and take its mean conditional log probability. Normalize the two scores with logsumexp if reporting choice probabilities. Strictly higher mean log probability for the correct continuation passes a member; ties fail. A pair passes only when both members pass. Also retain summed log likelihood as a secondary length-sensitivity measure. No absolute base-quality or chat gate.
counterfactual.token_boundary: Encode prompt and alternatives separately then concatenate their token IDs for suffix likelihood, so every alternative token is scored and boundary segmentation is fixed. Do not score prompt tokens. Use identical alternative token IDs for both members.

generation_rubric.unit: Each fixed prefix and its up-to-48-token continuation.

dimensions.relevance: 0 unrelated or incoherent; 1 partly relevant with drift; 2 follows the prefix throughout.
dimensions.local_consistency: 0 contradicts prefix or itself; 1 ambiguous or minor inconsistency; 2 consistent with supplied facts and own continuation.
dimensions.language: 0 mostly unreadable; 1 understandable with substantial grammatical defects; 2 readable connected language.
dimensions.repetition: 0 stuck in repeated phrase or loop; 1 distracting redundancy; 2 no distracting repetition.

generation_rubric.report: Report all dimension counts and means, loop rate, empty outputs and raw completions. A token-cap truncation alone is not a coherence failure. This is an informative base-completion rubric, without an absolute chat-readiness gate. Freeze rubric and disclose evaluator identity before outputs are judged.
